JPEG severity 3 remains the sharp joint optimum (31.27 vs 21.48 jpeg2 / 25.11 jpeg4). No candidate satisfies >40 dB or +2 dB improvement, so decision is NO_CHANGE; the pipeline is kept item-for-item identical to R0 and the overall verdict stays UNCERTAIN (pair0 joint PSNR in the 30-40 band plus inherent motion-kernel randomness).
